utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only caught bits of it second-hand—do you know the latest, especially what we’re collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Latest I’ve got, we’re in decent shape on basic supplies, and my kit can handle fence posts, faucet work, and railing fixes. We’re mostly still collecting extra lumber, a few general tools, and hoping to line up one more steady volunteer for the roof patching.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot—so I’ll pass along extra lumber, general tools, and that you still need one more steady person for the roof patching. I’ll still double-check with Mara in case there’s an updated list floating around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, I’m still hearing we need more hands for the roof patching and fence posts, but Mrs. Calder’s tools are already in and Ben’s meant to bring the lumber after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That matches what I’ve got, Tess—thank you. Please keep rounding up a few more folks for roof patching and fence posts, and remind everyone the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s good to know, Rosa—I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center and keep sending anyone handy with roof patching or fence posts your way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re still doing it, yes—by the garage this weekend. If Cleo can help, tools and spare fence hardware would make the biggest difference.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help, and I’ve already got a running count on tape, gloves, nails, and a few toolkits; I’ll check what we’ve got for fence hardware too. We’re still short on extension cords and probably tarps, so if you hear of any to borrow, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps a lot, thank you. I’ll ask around quietly about extension cords and tarps and let you know what turns up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, Jules, but can we pin down who’s handling pickups, the hours, and the exact storage address first so we’re not promising more than we can manage?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’m confirming the tools and volunteer coverage tonight, and by tomorrow I’ll bring the volunteer list and the exact hours and storage address so we can assign pickups cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps—I just want the pickup drivers, hours, and storage address nailed down tomorrow before we start assigning anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Mina—how’s the repair drive shaping up, and where do you want me to jump in?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still waiting on firm numbers by tomorrow, so can you take volunteer follow-up today? I’m making the sign-up sheet now, split by repair type with a handful of slots.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, absolutely—I’ll handle volunteer follow-up today and check in once I’ve got a clearer count for each repair type.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to plan around school drop-off and pickup—late morning, around 10:30, works best for me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—I’m blanking on the exact start time, sorry. I know I’m helping, but can you remind me if we’re doing late morning by the garage?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, late morning by the garage works—10:30 is probably the safest time for me if that still fits with everyone else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Bo, let’s keep it tidy: add every repair to the list today, and tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we’ll set the order and hand out the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, works for me — I’ll add what comes in today, and we can sort it by the mailboxes in the morning once the time’s nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Bo — keep it all on one clear list, and we’ll meet by the mailboxes tomorrow morning to set the order and assign the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I tell Ira anything firm, I should check with Faye on who’s definitely available this weekend and whether the tools are covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—check with Faye first, and just keep me posted while I’m out if you get anything firm on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do — I’ll check with Faye about confirmed availability and tool coverage, then I’ll let you know if anything firm comes through.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, I’m still pinning down the final assignments, but I’ve got volunteers lined up and I’m tracking tools and pickup coverage for this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—put me on Mrs. Carter’s rail first, then the Maple gate, and I’ll bring my level and wrench.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Leo—I’ve got you starting at Mrs. Carter’s rail, then the Maple gate, and I’m noting your level and wrench on the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll pass along that we’re leaning toward 10:30 and that you’re firming up the list today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Rey — tell them 10:30 is our best bet for now, and I’ll keep spreading the word while I lock in the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll keep it to 10:30 for now and mention that you’re still locking in the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still telling everyone about the repair drive so we get a strong turnout, and if folks ask for firm tool or availability details, Rosa or Faye should have the latest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s a big help, Vik—keep pointing people to Rosa for tool details and Faye for timing, and let me know if anyone wants to volunteer for setup or check-in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it, Sam—I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, point tool questions to Rosa and timing to Faye, and I’ll send any setup or check-in volunteers your way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, Kira, I think it’s still the garage this weekend, unless Mara changed it again. I’m heading over in a bit and trying not to forget the spare parts this time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you check and confirm before I count on it, Noah? I still need to know it’s definitely this weekend and who actually locked in the tools, volunteers, and storage.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah—sorry, I should confirm first; I’ll check whether it’s still this weekend at the garage and who’s got the tools, volunteers, and storage locked in, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got tape, nails, gloves, and a few toolkits accounted for, but we’re thin on extension cords and could use extra tarps if anyone can spare them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—I’ve mostly heard people are set on basics, so I can mention the need for extension cords and tarps when I check in one-on-one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—if anyone offers work gloves too, let me know, and I’ll keep the supply list tightened up for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m pulling the volunteer and tool list together now, Bo, and I’ll send it over as soon as I’ve got the counts pinned down. If Ira’s update comes through first, let me know so I can line everything up cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—send it when you’ve got it. I’m still waiting on Ira for the time and spot, and I’ll ping you the second it lands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo—I’m lining up the counts now, so once Ira’s update lands I can send you the full list and get Mina the volunteer slots too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re still on, Rosa—mostly fence hardware and tools so far. I can chip in a little too, just not much right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That helps a lot, Uli—thank you. We’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep you posted once I’ve got the final details confirmed tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright—Sunday at the community center works. Just send me the final details tomorrow, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10:30 works well for me, thanks—please add me to the list, and I’ll plan around school pickup once you’ve got the jobs sorted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Faye—I’ve got you down for 10:30, and I’ll send the repair list around as soon as the last few neighbors confirm so we can sort jobs fast.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn—that helps a lot; once the repair list comes through, I can figure out where I’m most useful before school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we promise anyone anything, can we pin down who’s doing pickups, what hours they’re covering, and the exact storage address?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good call — I don’t want to confirm anything until Faye verifies pickups, hours, and the storage address.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly—once Faye confirms who’s covering pickups, the hours, and the exact storage address, I’m comfortable saying yes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits second-hand too—I think it’s basic repair supplies and spare tools, but Mara’s the one with the full list. If you see her before I do, can you check the latest for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I'm still out on errands, but if I run into Mara first I’ll check the latest and pass it right along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—I've only got the rough version so far, and I don’t want to steer anyone wrong.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—I’m still happy to help, I just need a quick reminder what we’re collecting for the repair drive again.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’ve got spare tools from Mrs. Calder and Ben’s bringing lumber after lunch, so the big things we still need are folks lined up for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, roof patching and fence posts—got it. I left my toolbox by the shed again, but I can still come help if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it, Leo—I’ll sort the donated tools first and let folks know we’re collecting repair requests this week.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—send me the latest request list when you have it, and I’ll bring extension cords and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do—I’ll send you the latest request list once I’ve sorted the tools and talked to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still telling everyone about the repair drive and saying it’s at the garage this weekend unless we hear otherwise, but for firm availability or tool details, Faye’s the one to check with.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That matches what I’ve got: the repair drive is still set for the garage this weekend, and I’m noting Faye as the point for confirmed availability and tool details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating that around the neighborhood so we get a strong turnout.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Kira, I’m keeping every repair on one clear list today, so if you can help, please gather what still needs fixing and add it there; tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we’ll sort the order and assign jobs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but are we actually confirmed for the drive this weekend, Sam? I need to know the tools, volunteers, and where everything’s being stored before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, we’re confirmed for this weekend, and today I’m locking down the repair list while Mina handles the sign-up sheet; once that’s set, I’ll send you the tools, volunteer names, and where we’re storing everything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus, let’s keep it straightforward: add every repair to the list today, and tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we’ll set the order and hand out the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That works for me—I’ll add everything to the list today, and we’ll sort the order and jobs by the mailboxes tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Gus—that keeps it tidy, and tomorrow we can handle the urgent fixes first without any fuss.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—thanks, Jules. By the garage then, and we’re collecting tools plus spare fence hardware, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, by the garage—and yes, tools plus any spare fence hardware; I’m still confirming the volunteers and tool count tonight so we’ve got a solid list by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks for the reminder—I’ll try to grab my toolbox from by the shed this time, and I can help sort whatever people bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that we still need extension cords and work gloves, but you’ve got the real list, Mara—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Latest I’ve heard, we’re still short on extension cords and work gloves, and I’m collecting repair requests from neighbors this week too. If you can help track down either item, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks—that matches what I’d heard, then. I can spread the word about the extension cords and gloves, and I’ll mention you’re collecting repair requests too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Ira—just shoot over the time and spot when you hear, and I’ll keep things moving on my end.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Bo—I’m still out running errands, but the minute I hear the time and spot for the repair drive, I’ll send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll keep an eye out and nudge folks once your update comes through.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the supply list handy, and the main things we’re short on are extension cords and work gloves. If you hear of anyone with spare tarps too, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo—I’ll add extension cords, work gloves, and tarps to the list and keep spreading the word so we can lock down who’s bringing what fast.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—that helps a lot. I’ve got the counts on nails, tape, and gloves here, so once you hear back on cords and tarps we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Dane, just a quick update—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m making sure everyone gets the new details so things stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa—I’m glad you caught me; I’ll head to the community center Sunday and check in on where the tools are getting dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane—that helps a lot. I’m confirming the tool drop-off details now, and I’ll make sure you have the right spot before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Uli, before I finish the sheet, how many homes are actually signed up so far, and are we still just putting down a handful of slots by repair type?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Seven homes so far, I think. Just put down a few slots by repair type for now—I’m trying to keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Seven’s enough to get this moving. I’ll set up a few slots by repair type—can you confirm later today if that count changes?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pinning down the weekend confirmation now, Rey, and I’m tracking who’s handling pickups, tools, and the storage address so I can update everyone cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—I’ve only heard bits, but Gus said it’s mostly small fixes, and Faye said late morning around 10:30 works best for her. Once you’ve got pickups and the storage address pinned down, I can pass it along one-on-one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That lines up—I'll mark late morning, around 10:30, as the likely start and keep Gus’s small-fix note with it; once I lock pickups and the storage address, I’ll send you the exact details to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, then I’ll plan to stop by around 10:30 after drop-off if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 10:30 works—start with Mrs. Carter’s rail with me, and text if pickup timing shifts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll come by around 10:30 and I’ll text you right away if school pickup changes anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Tess, are we actually confirmed for this weekend yet, or are tools, volunteers, and the storage address still not locked in?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not fully locked in yet, Kira—Mrs. Calder’s already brought spare tools and Ben’s meant to haul lumber in after lunch, but the date and folks for roof patching and fence posts still need sorting out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still not actually confirmed then, right? Let me know once the date, roof crew, fence-post volunteers, and storage address are fully locked in.
